arguments.text: 8 km, 8 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Aim: even effort, pod ~190 W (pod CP 185 W + 20 kJ reserve spread over ~43 min; boat CP 111 W). Heart rate is compressed for this paddler (flat 172-173 bpm above 60 % of CP) so it cannot judge effort near threshold: use pod power, boat-model power and GPS speed. Let the start settle, then hold ~190 W pod. Watch for: weed on rudder (sudden speed drop at same pod power -> clear_rudder), pod drift (pod power rises vs boat power with GPS speed unchanged -> set pod_gain), radio course change (set_race_distance + tell), wind shift. Consider a CP check mid-race only if evidence says the test was off (12-min test power was flat 207-217 W, no fade). Final sprint (finish) about 600-800 m out, sized by reserve left.
